annotations.title: Crawl a website for links and tables

description: Crawl a website from a start address over plain HTTP and return one row per page with internal links, external links, file download links, HTML tables as rows, and lists. No AI and no browser, so pages built by JavaScript return little. Obeys robots.txt by default. Pay per event on Apify: 0.006 USD per page.

download_extensions.description: File extensions that count as download links. Default pdf, zip, xlsx, xls, docx, doc, pptx, csv, mp3, mp4, exe, dmg, msi, pkg, gz, tar, tgz, 7z, rar, iso, apk. Files are listed, never downloaded.

extract.description: Any of links, tables, lists, download_links. Default links, tables, lists. download_links adds one separate row per file link, charged as download-link-row; the download_links field on page rows is always filled at no extra charge.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_depth.description: How many links to follow from a start address. 0 reads only the start address. Default 10.

max_pages.description: Pages to read across the whole run, up to 10,000. Default 100.

obey_robots.description: yes (default): skip pages robots.txt disallows and honor its crawl delay up to 5 seconds. no: read them, only if you have the right to.

proxy_mode.description: pool (default): the Apify proxy pool only, charged as page-row; a page that refuses it gets a free blocked row. auto: a refused page is retried on residential addresses, and a page read that way is charged as residential-page-row. residential: every page uses residential addresses and is charged as residential-page-row.

same_domain_only.description: yes (default): follow links only on the start address's host and its subdomains. no: also follow links to other sites, up to Maximum pages. Links to other sites are listed either way.

start_urls.description: Web addresses to start from, up to 100. A bare domain such as example.com is read as https.

use_sitemap.description: yes (default): also queue the addresses in /sitemap.xml, which finds pages no link reaches. no: follow links only.
